subject: Tesla Italia TSL Destination Charging direct tariff surface

evidence.finding: Tesla states Destination Charging prices are shown on each site's pin in the vehicle touchscreen or Tesla app; billing is per kWh; final invoices are available in app; prices may change; some sites may apply idle fees.
Tesla publishes the Italy Destination Charging site directory, providing a first-party station discovery surface.

decision.reason: Direct Tesla tariff is site-specific and dynamically exposed in Tesla app/touchscreen. No deterministic mapping from the 2,421 current PUN TSL EVSE to exact current site-pin prices was recovered in this pass.

antiRepeat.resumeCondition: Tesla app/site-pin payload, public/guest backend exposing Destination Charging price, or exact station/EVSE-scoped first-party tariff evidence

nextAction: Do not search for a national TSL tariff. Recover the Tesla Destination Charging site-pin/app payload and map exact PUN EVSE/stations to site prices; preserve idle-fee fields where exposed.
